# MXI Ventures

> Operations work for small and mid sized businesses in the Phoenix valley. Michael McKitterick finds the places where a business is quietly losing money, and works with the owner to solve them. For the past two decades he has run operations for construction, real estate, data analysis, manufacturing and distribution companies, mostly in Phoenix.

MXI Ventures LLC is a one person operation based in Phoenix, Arizona. There is no agency, no account management layer, and no reseller relationship. Michael handles every engagement from the first conversation to the last file.

## What is offered

- **Websites** (https://mxiventures.com/websites/): An audit of an existing website, read the way a customer reads it, delivered as a written list of what the site is costing the business. Common findings are services the business performs that the site never names, contact details buried several clicks deep, hours that were never updated, and reviews earned elsewhere that no visitor ever sees. If the owner wants it fixed, Michael rebuilds the site. The audit is free. If the owner wants the site rebuilt, it is a flat fee quoted before work starts, most around $1,500, about a week of working time, mockup first, with two rounds of changes included. There is no monthly retainer requirement and no software upsell.
- **Operations consulting**: Finding the inefficiencies, the workflow gaps, and the places where profit quietly leaves a business. Arranged by conversation.
- **Research and due diligence**: Research for people who need an answer they can defend, not a summary. Scope, deadline and price agreed before work starts. Arranged by conversation.

## The operating view

A bad website is usually an operations problem rather than a design problem. Nobody chose a bad font. What happens is that nobody in the business owns the question of whether the front door still describes what the company actually sells, so nobody has looked in several years. The website is simply where that failure is cheapest to find and most visible to fix.

## Who it is for

Owner operated businesses in and around Phoenix, Arizona, including the trades, construction, real estate, light manufacturing and distribution. Typically under one hundred employees.
